summary: Completed backend testing of Magic Link with Redirect URL feature for WhatsApp RFQ integration. All 33 tests passed (21 new redirect tests + 12 existing magic link tests). Feature is working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Magic link with redirect URL feature is fully functional. Test phone 9330389049 works for magic link generation. Magic links expire in 30 minutes (updated from 15 min).

magic_link_generation_with_redirect.details: POST /api/auth/magic-link/generate accepts optional redirect_url parameter and returns it in response

redirect_url_security.details: Only internal paths starting with /vendor/, /buyer/, /admin/, /dashboard, /rfq/, /quotes, /orders are accepted. External URLs, protocol-relative URLs, and unauthorized paths are rejected (set to null)

magic_link_verification_with_redirect.details: GET /api/auth/magic-link/verify/{token} returns stored redirect_url or defaults to /{role}/dashboard

generate_magic_link_for_vendor_helper.details: Internal helper function used by WhatsApp RFQ notifications correctly generates magic links with redirect paths

notify_vendors_rfq_endpoint.details: POST /api/whatsapp/notify-rfq endpoint accessible and requires authentication

single_use_tokens.details: Magic link tokens are single-use - second verification attempt returns 400 error

token_expiry.details: Magic links expire in 30 minutes (configurable for RFQ use case)

frontend_magic_login_page.details: MagicLogin.jsx correctly handles verification response including redirect_url, stores in localStorage, and redirects user

api_endpoints_tested.notes: Generates magic links with redirect to /vendor/rfq/{rfq_id}
